QuestInfo.name: Excavated: Permanent Marker
QuestInfo.0: You found one of Spiegelmann's lost tools while you were looking for artifacts.
QuestInfo.1: Bring this back to Spiegelmann. He'll probably be excited!
QuestInfo.2: You were sure Spiegelmann was going to flip out over the marker you gave him, but he didn't even know if it was his.
